verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted search platform with an official CLI and API clients, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents search analytics, click tracking and event collection. Nothing in it describes a setting, flag or policy that lets a user opt out of the product's own telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
